extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Humana plan available in Pasco County has a $20 monthly premium, a $535 drug deductible and a $5700 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, delivered the disclaimer before discussing benefits, and collected the Scope of Appointment. The appointment was scheduled for 48 hours later.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Dana! You effectively followed all the necessary steps and delivered the disclaimer before discussing the benefits. One area for improvement is ensuring the appointment is scheduled at least 24 hours after the SOA is collected. Next time, try to schedule the appointment at least a day after the SOA is signed.

crm_record.next_step: Follow up with the customer on the scheduled appointment and review the plan details.
